# Opal Pettigrew

## Overview

- **Age:** 16 or 17 years old at the time of her death  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c26 P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004), [v3 c14 P0](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0000), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c11 P11](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0011)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c11 P11](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0011), [v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018)</sub>
- **Role:** School student  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P15](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

Opal is a very attractive girl with lovely skin, curly brown hair, and large, vivid blue eyes. As her health declines due to consumption, she becomes extremely slender, frail, and pale, with a feverish flush on her cheeks and delicate, transparent hands.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 c25 P43](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0043), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 c14 P0](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0000)_

## Personality

Opal is cheerful, lively, and optimistic, possessing a strong love for fun, society, and flirtation. She is deeply preoccupied with boys, suitors, and romance, enjoying the attention of multiple admirers. Beneath her superficial preoccupation with suitors, she harbors a deep capacity for love and a fearful, desperate struggle against her terminal illness, attempting to hide her terminal condition behind a facade of cheerful excitement.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v2 c26 P5](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0005), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059), [v3 c11 P5](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0005), [v3 c14 P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), [v3 c14 P17](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0017)_

- Cheerful and lively  <sub>[v2 c26 P5](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0005), [v3 c11 P5](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0005)</sub>

## Abilities

- Skillful at curing warts using an enchanted stone  <sub>[v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018)</sub>
- Canning and preserving fruit  <sub>[v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018)</sub>
- Creative story writing for school clubs  <sub>[v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020)</sub>

## Goals

- To enjoy life, have many suitors, and eventually marry for love  <sub>[v1 c26 P15](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0015), [v3 c14 P17](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0017)</sub>

## History

Opal attended Brierley School alongside Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke, where she was known for her beauty and dramatic reactions. She joined the story writing club and later attended Regent's Academy to prepare for her Entrance exams. After graduating, she planned to teach at Pale Sands, but fell ill with galloping consumption following a severe bout of lung congestion. Despite her declining health, Opal maintained a cheerful exterior and continued to talk about her suitors and future plans. During her final summer, she confided her deep fears of death and her true feelings for Herb Tranter to Nell. Opal passed away peacefully in her sleep shortly thereafter and was buried in the Brierley churchyard.

_Sources: [v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v2 c27 P30](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0030), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 c14 P17](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0017), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030), [v3 c14 P31](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0031)_

## Quotes

> I’m going to get a boyfriend the moment I turn fifteen.  <sub>[v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005)</sub>

> I’ve been fighting so hard to live—and it isn’t any use—I have to die—and leave everything I care for.  <sub>[v3 c14 P14](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0014)</sub>
